subject: IE 9  vs Crome and Shiny Server

messages.author: 185b691c84b200d6
messages.subject: IE 9  vs Crome and Shiny Server
parts:
Hello,

I do observe a strange behaviour using Shiny-Server and IE 9.
The setup is as follow:
Shiny Server 0.3.5 on a VM with an Ubuntu Server 12.04 LTS
R 3.0.2
Shiny 0.8.0

The applications are working fine on my laptop using on W7 IE9 and Chrome.
On another computer (using my coperate account) the app fails with IE9, as it e.g. does not show the new datatables. On this computer using Chrome the app works fine.
The source code for IE9 is identical in both cases.

So it should be something linked to the IE9 options used on both computers.

But....what might that be?

By the way, both computers are using the same Image installed two weeks ago and we do not have Admin rights.

Thank you very much.

Jürgen
